mapper.insert: insert into credit_account(user_id, balance, frozen, total_granted, total_consumed, total_expired, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{totalGranted}, #{totalConsumed}, #{totalExpired}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update credit_account set balance = balance + #{amount}, total_granted = total_granted + #{amount}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into credit_batch(user_id, event_id, scene, amount, remaining, granted_at, expires_at, state, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{eventId}, #{scene}, #{amount}, #{remaining}, #{grantedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{state}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, event_id, scene, amount, remaining, granted_at, expires_at, state from credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and state = 'active' and remaining > 0 and expires_at > #{now} order by expires_at asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into credit_ledger(user_id, biz_no, batch_id, scene, type, delta, balance_after, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{bizNo}, #{batchId}, #{scene}, #{type}, #{delta}, #{balanceAfter}, now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, balance, frozen, total_granted, total_consumed, total_expired, create_time, update_time from credit_account order by id limit #{limit}
select coalesce(sum(remaining), 0) from credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and state = 'active' and remaining > 0
mapper.insert: insert into credit_reconcile_diff(run_id, user_id, account_balance, batch_remaining, ledger_sum, diff, reason, state, create_time) values (#{runId}, #{userId}, #{accountBalance}, #{batchRemaining}, #{ledgerSum}, #{diff}, #{reason}, #{state}, now())
mapper.select: select min(expires_at) from credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and state = 'active' and remaining > 0
